title: How to Progress Faster in Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD
subtitle: Where gems and relics come from, and how to spend your time for the best return.
description: How to progress faster in Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD, earn gems from the daily challenge, castle and mutators, collect relics and spend on the skill tree wisely.
card: How to progress faster in Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD, the daily challenge, castle income, relics, mutators and endless mode, and what to do with your gems.

faq.q: How do I get gems in Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD?
faq.a: Gems come from winning campaign levels, the daily challenge, endless mode, goals and the season track, mutator bonuses and your castle, which pays gems every 8 hours. Gems can also be bought in the store, but it is optional.

Relics are never sold. They drop at random from boss kills in campaign runs, from winning a level with more stars than before, and as the reward of season tier 30. A repeat drop raises that relic one level.

faq.q: What does the daily challenge give?
faq.a: Each UTC day has one fixed run with a set map, mutators and tower pool, the same for everyone. It pays 2 gems per wave reached up to wave 50, plus a streak bonus of 5 gems per extra day, up to 7 days.
